verification.admission: AdmissionReference is a locator only. Resolve and independently verify actual typed admitted fact, exact owner/tenant/program, saved metadata and physical/hydrated cut, original root/episode/actor/intent and immutable content.

verification.resultAndRecovery: Current public authorization precedes replay. Original result/receipt and unknown-append recovery stay exact; requested cancellation propagates. Unavailable proof/content remains transient; corruption/changed intent is permanent; no inferred absence/release.
verification.implementationStatus: Installed pointer/handler/process presence is not proof of conformance. Field/wire migration and required behavioral tests remain separately verifiable implementation work.
